extras.name: _LegacyViewport
extras.reason: Shared independently owned legacy viewport events/cache/geometry contract removes docs-private upstream ruler imports. The underscore helper is exported only from legacy-core to keep one class/token/root owner across families; it introduces no modern API forwarding. Historical-source and structural/manual-argument behavior proof plus packed identity/native qualification remain required.

extras.name: _LegacyTableDefinitionOwner
extras.reason: Finite NgModule-exported ownership adapter for four public CDK definition selectors inside legacy tables. It binds only definitions whose nearest public CdkTable is an actual MatLegacyTable; current CDK tables remain peer-owned. Public export is required for Angular library compilation of the NgModule export. No modern API forwarding or private token export; native/packed qualification remains required.

extras.name: ɵLegacyTableColumnClasses
extras.reason: The existing owned column-class directive is exported by MatLegacyTableModule for mixed public CDK cells in legacy columns. Angular partial library compilation requires the identical directive to be reachable from this entrypoint (reproduced NG3001). This internal alias changes no selector,constructor,template,style or existing consumer API and forwards no current private API. Actual packed/native gates remain required.

limitations: Each extra is scoped to entry (family/kind), symbol, and rationale. A name in an unlisted entry is unclassified.
Signature differences live in signature-differences.json as exact pairs, not a wildcard.
